integrity: The all-parameter claim is established by a group multiplication and unit decomposition proof; six independently enumerated cases corroborate but do not prove it. No independent scientific audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite commutative local rings of odd residue characteristic with nonzero square-zero maximal ideal; the new focus is radical dimension at least two. Does not classify full group structure or character tables. General priority cannot be guaranteed.
title: Element-order spectra distinguish split and mixed-characteristic square-zero affine groups
